Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
The single 5 oz bag ($5.99) is perfectly fine if you want to test the taste or keep your upfront spending as low as possible.
However, if you know you will eat it, the Twin-Pack ($10.99) is genuinely worth the extra $5. It drops the per-bag price to about $5.50 (saving you $2.19 off the total regular price of buying two individually), and because the mix is completely shelf-stable until mixed with water, there is no risk of it spoiling in your pantry.
